title: Pan-Seared Seafood Paella Croquettes
description: A creative twist on traditional Spanish paella, these crispy croquettes are filled with succulent seafood and served with a side of tangy aioli.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the seafood paella mix and cook until lightly browned.
Add the chicken broth and stir to combine.
Add the cod fish and mussels, and cook until the seafood is cooked through.
Stir in the cheese until melted.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature.
Shape the mixture into small patties.
Dredge the patties in flour, shaking off excess.
Heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the croquettes until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with aioli.
